Hello, friends! I just read this hilarious post and it inspired me to write some Fatfiction; you know, the story in that post from the fatty's point of view. This is my first attempt at this, so bear with me but I hope you enjoy.

Dear Friends of Tumblr, You will not believe what happened to me and my daughter at the park today!!! There was so much fatphobia, fat hate, and discrimination I can't even believe it! I am not only seething with hate for everyone with thin privilege, I'm struggling to remind myself to love my body, love my fat, and love me for what I am. But today when I took my daughter to the park, a whole family with thin privilege almost broke me. Yep, you read that right, my daughter and I were mocked by an entire family.

After we did our daily trip to McDonald's for lunch, my daughter and I have this tradition of going to the park to play. We happened to be a bit behind schedule as I only had time to make breakfast for my daughter that morning and I couldn't eat. We got to the park, and there was a hetero-normative family with two kids and a dog that I noticed right away. They were showing off with everything they did, and just really taking every single step overzealously. Hoping we could ignore it, my daughter and I headed for the playground.

When we got to the playground, I just let my daughter go on the play equipment so I could play Words With Friends on my phone--sometimes I can't get through the day without talking to someone in the Tumblr community--no one understands what we go through! She plays on the play structure, and I play on my phone and watch her. A few minutes after we got there, the hetero-normative family showed up. They started playing some kind of tag game on the play equipment, which I know isn't safe on the play equipment because it has weight limits--I broke a glider in middle school trying to glide on it and I just don't risk it anymore. My daughter knows not to use the glider also. My daughter didn't tell me this until later, but she said when she was playing by the family, one of their kids looked at her and said goadingly "WE'RE playing TAG!" because he wanted to rub it in my daughter's face that she's too fat to play tag. My daughter came to me and asked me if we could play tag too, but I was right in the middle of my Words With Friends game.

Then the worst thing happened. The family was having a good time, laughing and playing, and I swear I heard them all sing a song together having to do with being fit and how fat is bad. It was so fatphobic, I wanted to leave right then, but my daughter was still asking me to play tag. I thought about it, and I looked up for a second only to see the father of the hetero-normative family look me in the eye with one of his kids on his back, say "BET YOU CAN'T DO THIS, FATTIE!" and he jumped on the glider and glided across JUST TO MOCK ME.

It is NOT okay to rub your fitness in a fat person's face!!!!! It is NOT okay to tell my daughter you're playing tag!!! It is NOT okay to mock me for being fat!!!! It is NOT okay to sing fatphobic songs in public spaces!!!!! I couldn't believe this family, while I wanted to say something to them, I was just so humiliated and put down that I took my daughter and left.

We need to end heteronormativepatriarchal fat hate!!!!! Health at every size!!!! Thanks for reading, I knew Tumblr would understand!!!!!!
